description: Generate production source code from domain model and story specifications
goal: Create clean, maintainable production code that implements story behavior
inputs: Domain model, story specifications, and test files
outputs: Source code files (.py, .js, etc.) with production implementation
instructions: Create clean, maintainable production code that implements story behavior

actions.name: build
instructions: code: write production source code files (.py, .js, etc.) that implement story behavior and make tests pass
After writing code files, update domain_concepts at the epic level with code class mappings:
**code_class field** - Add to domain_concepts entries (at epic level only):
- Only add at the class level - do NOT map individual functions/methods
- Maps the domain concept to the implementing class
- Update the 'module' field with the actual module path if it differs
Refine domain model concepts, relationships, and responsibilities based on code implementation patterns and requirements
Do NOT add code mappings to story level or scenario level - only update domain_concepts at epic level

actions.name: validate
instructions: code: validate source code quality AND domain model refinements
Validate that domain concepts are properly mapped to code classes in story-graph.json
MANDATORY: Discover and pass code_files parameter - CodeScanner requires explicit file paths to scan for violations

actions.name: rules
instructions: Display digested rules for this behavior as AI context

trigger_words.description: Behavior-level trigger words - specific to production code generation behavior
